title: Book Two · Chapter 38: Finished
story:
On Wednesday, Ronan sees the reading folder on Miss Wu's desk.

It is underneath two large books. His name is inside, on one of the pages. He cannot see it from his chair.

Leo opens his school bag. The yellow pencil is still in its cloth case.

“Did you finish yesterday?” he asks.

“Yes.”

“So did I.”

Ronan waits for another question. Leo takes out a different book and asks Jun to move his bag.

During the morning, they read about two children in a garden. This time Miss Wu asks them to find a person in each sentence. Ronan follows with one finger. He keeps the garden boy separate from the girl.

At break, Mei sits at the window with her own drawing. A curtain is open above a little pot. Ronan looks at the space beside it.

“Can I draw a dog there?”

“No. I want that space empty.”

He takes his hand back.

“Not even a small dog?”

“Not in this picture.”

Jun brings another scrap. He has drawn a box for a dog. Leo puts two round eyes above it.

“Now the dog is too tall,” Ronan says.

“Then the box is for its lunch.”

They make a second box, much lower, and put a bone inside. Mei looks over and laughs. She goes back to her curtain.

After school, Ronan helps Mum carry an empty bag home from a customer. The mended coat is no longer inside. Mum has her payment in the little purse.

“Did you do your own page?” she asks.

“Yesterday.”

“How did it go?”

“I finished.”

Mum waits a moment. Ronan tells her about the dog and the two lines. He does not mention his first answer.

“Do you have the page?”

“Miss Wu kept it.”

“Then we can look when she gives it back.”

At home, Mum takes the skirt from its hook. A little thread is loose near the pocket. She cuts it and puts the skirt away again.

Ronan goes to his own shelf. His bowl story is still in his book. He can read that one from the beginning to the end.

He starts to tell it to Mum. She stops him gently.

“I need to count this cloth first.”

He waits by the window. Mr Qiu is closing his little table. Mrs Lan has a large basket in the path. She moves it aside before Dad comes through the gate.

Dad's hands are dusty. He tells Mum the drawer is still at work. He is checking one side at a time.

“Did it open?” Ronan asks.

“Yes. But I need to check it again after the work.”

Ronan thinks about his own page inside the folder. Miss Wu can open it and read every answer.

Mum finishes with the cloth. “Now I can listen.”

He brings the bowl story to her. He begins slowly. This time he says the woman, not she.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

underneath＝在下面；separate＝分开、不混淆；payment＝报酬；mend＝修补。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan说“我做完了”，是否等于他确认每道题都对？
2. Mei怎样说明自己对图画的安排？

## 读句子

Miss Wu / kept / it.＝Miss Wu／留下了／那张纸。
